name: Otonashi Yuzuru
source:
Otonashi is the main protagonist of Angel Beats!. Due to his past, he has a caring personality and does not want anyone to experience pain or sadness. [spoiler]He lost his memory after his death in a train accident.[/spoiler]

[From [url=http://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Angel_Beats!]Wikipedia[/url]]
